reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: UGA Malaria - Uganda (01-Jan-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Uganda, Malaria, Ministry of Finance, Planning and Economic Development of the Republic of Uganda (MoFPED)This program has the following goals: By 2020, reduce annual malaria deaths from 2013 levels to near zero (from 29 per 100,000 to <1 per100,000). By 2020, reduce malaria morbidity to 30 cases per 1000 population (80% reduction from 2013 levels). By 2020, reduce malaria parasite prevalence to less than 7% (over 85% reduction from the 2010 levels from 45% to 7%). The objectives of this program are: By 2016, the programme is able to manage and coordinate multi-sectoral malaria reduction efforts at all levels.. By 2017, achieve and sustain protection of at least 85% of the population at risk through recommended malaria prevention measures.. By 2017, all health facilities and District Health Offices report routinely and timely on malaria programme performance.. By 2017, all malaria epidemic prone districts have the capacity for epidemic preparedness and response.. By 2017, at least 85% of the population practices correct malaria prevention and management measures.. By 2018, achieve and sustain a at least 90% of malaria cases in the public and private sectors and community level receive prompt treatment according to national guidelines.

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for UGA-M-MoFPEDP01
Confirmed malaria cases (microscopy or RDT) per 1000 persons per year
Parasite prevalence: Proportion of children aged 6-59 months with malaria infection
Inpatient malaria deaths per 1000 persons per year (disaggregated by sex; age <5, 5+).
Malaria test positivity rate.
Outcome indicators targets and results for UGA-M-MoFPEDP01
Proportion of households with at least one insecticide-treated net for every two people
Proportion of children under five years old who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Proportion of pregnant women who slept under an insecticide-treated net the previous night
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for UGA-M-MoFPEDP01
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Proportion of confirmed malaria cases that received first-line antimalarial treatment in the community
CM-other 1: Percentage of Health Facilities that reported no stock out of first line anti-malarial medicines (ACTs) lasting more than 7 days in the previous month
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test in the community
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to at-risk populations through mass campaigns
